summary: Which parts of qnfo-workers are the self-governing development platform (core), which are QNFO's own applications that run on it (customer zero), and which are the owner's private personal plane that never ships with the product. scripts/product_boundary.mjs fails when a live worker is in no class or in two.

classes.core: The product: the tick, the issue and claim ledgers, the code loop, the deploy path with probes and revert, the model router, the fleet graph, observability and the operator console.
classes.app: QNFO research and reach applications. They are the first customer of the core and leave the repository when the core is extracted.
classes.personal: The owner's private plane (DOMAIN-PLANE-1, q08.org). Never part of the product, never copied into it.

qnfo-fleet-control.role: kernel: the 10-minute tick, metric triggers, loop watch, trust ledger refresh, remediation contracts
qnfo-fleet-control.entangled: charter, portfolio and research-specific steps live in the same 1.4 MB file

qnfo-code-orchestrator.role: code loop: issue with a code-task line to a planned, tested, merged pull request on open models

qnfo-deploy-guard.role: work claims and the secret lease shared by every agent lane

qnfo-ops.role: canonical deploy (/ops/deploy) with lock, ledger and bindings; the server-side ops agent

qnfo-ai.role: model router with capability gates, fallbacks and soft budget routing

qnfo-ai-calibration.role: calibrates and stress-tests every routed model endpoint

qnfo-waste-agent.role: finds and removes spend that produces nothing

qnfo-memory-mcp.role: fleet code and topology graph (blast radius) and the knowledge graph

qnfo-observability.role: makes the fleet observable to itself (trace ingest into D1)

qnfo-cloud-ops.role: task runner for D1 workflows, owner-step watch and probe cadence

qnfo-github-steward.role: mirrors the issue ledger to GitHub and keeps issue hygiene

qnfo-intent-orchestrator.role: turns a request from any client into an issue the loops act on

qnfo-tools-mcp.role: MCP tool server for agent clients

qnfo-agents.role: Cloudflare Agents SDK runtime reachable from the console

qnfo-containers-pilot.role: container executor for Python and workspace jobs

qnfo-doc-gate.role: gate that keeps documents tied to code

qnfo-fleet-dashboard.role: operator console (fleet.qnfo.org): queue, decisions, prompted-recall questions, owner tasks
qnfo-fleet-dashboard.entangled: research pages and the private owner documents are served from the same worker

qnfo-research-exec.role: autonomous research pipeline: ground, draft, referee, revise, publish

qnfo-gateway.role: qnfo.org and papers.qnfo.org, the home of record

ultrastable-site.role: public presence of the product: ultrastable.io, with .app and .net redirects, live proof read from the platform claims

phases.what: This manifest and its check: every live worker is classified, so new code lands on one side.
A short default policy pack (the agreement every agent lane reads) extracted from CLAUDE.md and the doctrine; QNFO keeps its owner directives as an overlay.
Core tables move from qnfo-audit into their own D1 database; QNFO tables stay. The kernel reads core tables only.
Tenant settings (account, repository, hosts, model ladder, owner contact) read from configuration instead of constants.
A second installation on a repository outside qnfo-workers proves the core runs without QNFO's applications.

claims.rule: ULTRASTABLE-CLAIMS-1: every claim the product page makes has a probe in product_claims; the page runs it live and a contract runs it hourly.
